- **Lead Technical Specialist** — Redoubt Solutions, LLC — 2018–Present — Work-from-home / school-from-home workstations; wired/wireless and multi-site Wi-Fi & mesh; Plex/NAS/Unraid media servers; gaming and crypto mining rigs; WordPress/site security; smart home (Home Assistant, ESPHome/Tasmota, UniFi Protect, MQTT, Zigbee/Z-Wave, and related platforms); web builds for individuals, political, and community groups
- **System Architect and Software Test Engineer** — Lifetime Products — 2005–2025 — Regression/acceptance testing leadership; UI and non-UI defect management; multi-program test strategy; Windows/IIS/SQL/firewall ops and security monitoring; mobile/web architecture; HTML5/CSS3/JS mentoring and standards
- **Board of Directors** — United Precious Metals Association — 2015–2021 — Governance, committees, strategic initiatives
- **Senior Editor, Journalist, Tech Evangelist** — Pocketnow — 2010–2017 — Android/tech writing, reviews, How-To, HD video for site and YouTube; smart home, privacy, and security coverage
- **Manager (Regional, Returns, Production, Store, Technical Support)** — Totally Awesome Computers — 2001–2005 — Regional staffing; RMA process overhaul (inventory reduction); store/production ops; AR collections; out-of-state tech support; built Technical Support department protocols
- **Web Services Manager & Senior Web Developer** — ABC Office — 2001 — Team leadership; large-site performance and markup fixes; B2C cart across ~15,000 pages in ~90 days
- **Technology Director, Interactive** — BOWG Advertising (Blain Olsen White Gurr) — 1999–2001 — Interactive sites/web pods; QC leadership; Digital Signature Initiative
- **KnowledgeBase Administrator** — Iomega — 1996–1999 — Automated Support Group; award-winning global support site; KnowledgeBase strategy (two iterations)
- **Account Manager & Escalations Technician** — Prodigy (via SPS Payment Systems) — 1994–1995 — Liaison to R&D; departmental intranet/KB prototype; escalations; Hearing Impaired support (TDD/TTY)
